description: stamped_exe = original exe || payload || footer; footer = uint32 BE payload length (4) || SHA-256 of payload (32) || ASCII "RIVETIT-EMBED-v1" (16) = 52 bytes; payload <= 16384 bytes. The agent reads the LAST 52 bytes of its own exe. Hex strings are lowercase.

vectors.name: with_ca_and_unicode
vectors.note: UTF-8 department, CA PEM with newlines, escaped quotes

vectors.name: one_byte_exe
vectors.note: the original executable is a single byte

vectors.name: empty_exe
vectors.note: degenerate: nothing before the payload (the agent finds exe_length 0)

vectors.name: magic_inside_body
vectors.note: the magic string inside the exe body is not a footer (a real agent binary contains the constant)

vectors.name: minimal_payload
vectors.note: two-byte payload: the format check passes, semantic checks belong to the parser

negative.name: bad_magic
negative.reason: last byte of the magic changed

negative.name: bad_sha256
negative.reason: one bit of the stored hash flipped

negative.name: truncated_one_byte
negative.reason: file truncated by one byte (magic incomplete)

negative.name: length_exceeds_file
negative.reason: declared length larger than the file

negative.name: length_16385
negative.reason: declared length one over the 16384 bound, hash valid

negative.name: length_off_by_one_short
negative.reason: length does not match the hashed payload

negative.name: length_off_by_one_long
negative.reason: length does not match the hashed payload (includes one exe byte)

negative.name: payload_not_json
negative.reason: footer valid, payload is not JSON: the parser must refuse

negative.name: payload_json_array
negative.reason: footer valid, payload is a JSON array, not an object
